description: Check a rebuild started by `rebuild_doc` and publish it when it is done. Returns the current stage while it is still building, so call it again after a pause. When the rebuild has finished this publishes it as a new HTML doc in the user's farm and returns the share link and the quality scores. Safe to call repeatedly: publishing twice returns the same doc.

account.description: Email address of the farm to act on. Omit for the signed-in farm. Only a connected account is accepted; call list_accounts to see which.

name.description: Name for the rebuilt doc. Defaults to the original's name.

name: check_rebuild
title: Collect a finished rebuild
